value.title: Phase 1: TypeScript + TSX grammars
value.summary: One coder, tasks in order, every assertion pinned to a backpressure row.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom; stop-and-ask o-prime on anything outside the fence.

value.title: Wire tree-sitter-typescript: workspace dep, Language::TypeScript/Tsx, extension map, as_str, grammar()
value.success: the workspace builds with tree-sitter-typescript 0.23.2 against tree-sitter 0.26; `for_extension("ts"|"mts"|"cts")` → TypeScript, `"tsx"` → Tsx; a .ts fixture scans with language typescript

value.title: Fixtures + golden forests for declarations (class, abstract class, interface, enum, type alias, methods, signatures, default export, namespace) and a JSX-heavy tsx
value.success: goldens checked in; every declaration kind appears with the expected address and span; tsx parses

value.title: Generic value-shape rule + classify decisions: variable_declarator / public_field_definition whose `value` is arrow_function|function_expression|generator_function → Function named by the binding; internal_module → Container; classify tests enumerate every TS kind decision
value.success: language-agnostic code in source.rs/classify.rs; six binding shapes pass; mutation receipts recorded

value.title: Regression + gate
value.success: rust/python/markdown tests unchanged and green; clippy clean; gate green on the PR sha

value.title: Pre-prod scan receipt + PR
value.success: per-file element table for ~/pi-hacking/pij/.pi/extensions/pij/**/*.ts before/after in the PR body; the exact prod re-ingest command and search query o-prime will run
